command:
# summarize recent changes
$stat = git diff --stat HEAD~3
$stat | Select-Object -Last 10
if (-not $stat) { Write-Host 'No changes in last 3 commits' }
git fetch origin && git rebase origin/main
Get-Command node, python, git, dotnet -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Name, Source
Get-Process | Sort-Object CPU -Descending | Select-Object -First 10 Name, Id, CPU
Get-Service | Where-Object Status -eq 'Running' | Select-Object -First 15 Name, DisplayName
Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3000 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object LocalAddress, State, OwningProcess
Get-ItemProperty 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion' | Select-Object ProductName, DisplayVersion, CurrentBuild
Get-ChildItem 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall' | Get-ItemProperty | Where-Object DisplayName -like '*Visual Studio*' | Select-Object DisplayName, DisplayVersion
Get-WinEvent -LogName Application -MaxEvents 20 | Where-Object LevelDisplayName -eq 'Error' | Select-Object TimeCreated, ProviderName, Message
Get-ScheduledTask | Where-Object State -eq 'Ready' | Select-Object -First 10 TaskName, TaskPath
Get-ChildItem Cert:\CurrentUser\My | Select-Object Subject, NotAfter, Thumbprint
Get-ChildItem Cert:\LocalMachine\Root | Where-Object NotAfter -lt (Get-Date).AddDays(90) | Select-Object Subject, NotAfter
Get-CimInstance Win32_LogicalDisk -Filter "DriveType=3" | Select-Object DeviceID, Size, FreeSpace

$start = Get-Date
npm run lint 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 15
$elapsed = (Get-Date) - $start
Write-Host ("Lint took {0:N1}s" -f $elapsed.TotalSeconds)
Start-Job -ScriptBlock { Get-ChildItem C:\Users\dev\projects\api -Recurse -Filter *.json | Measure-Object | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Count } | Wait-Job | Receive-Job
Invoke-Command -ScriptBlock { Get-Process -Name pwsh | Select-Object Id, StartTime }
git stash list; git stash show -p stash@{0} | Select-Object -First 40

$msg = @'
fix: handle null user in session middleware

The middleware dereferenced req.user before auth ran.
'@
git commit -m $msg

$pkg = Get-Content package.json -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
$pkg.version = '1.4.2'
$pkg | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 20 | Set-Content package.json -Encoding utf8
Write-Host "Bumped to $($pkg.version)"

$params = @{
    Path        = 'C:\Users\dev\projects\api\src'
    Recurse     = $true
    Filter      = '*.py'
    ErrorAction = 'SilentlyContinue'
}
Get-ChildItem @params | Measure-Object | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Count

$out = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'build-output'
if (Test-Path $out) { Remove-Item $out -Recurse -Force }
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $out | Out-Null
dotnet publish -c Release -o $out 2>&1 | Tee-Object -FilePath (Join-Path $out 'publish.log')
Get-ChildItem $out | Select-Object -First 10 Name

# Find largest files in the repo
Get-ChildItem -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
    Sort-Object Length -Descending |
    Select-Object -First 10 @{n='MB';e={[math]::Round($_.Length/1MB,2)}}, FullName |
    Format-Table -AutoSize

$staging = "$env:TEMP\staging-$(Get-Date -Format yyyyMMdd)"
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $staging -Force | Out-Null
Copy-Item .\dist\* $staging -Recurse
Compress-Archive -Path "$staging\*" -DestinationPath "$staging.zip" -Force
Write-Host "Created $staging.zip"

$result = python -c "import sys; print(sys.version)" 2>&1
if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { Write-Host "Python OK: $result" } else { Write-Host "Python failed" }
npm view react version && npm outdated
python -m pip install --upgrade pip || Write-Host 'pip upgrade failed'
Get-WmiObject Win32_OperatingSystem | Select-Object Caption, Version, LastBootUpTime
